scenario.title: ZHITOMIR-BERDICHEV OFFENSIVE - 27 DEC 1943
intro.text:
ZHITOMIR-BERDICHEV OFFENSIVE - 27 DEC 1943

East of Zhitomir, Ukraine

You task is to defeat the opposing German 4th Panzer Army of Army Group South and the liberation of the Zhytomyr Oblast region, including the cities of Zhitomir and Berdichev.

ORDERS
Capture all VH!

NOTES
Attention - winter conditions! If possible, equip your troops with tracked movement. Check if you can switch between wheeled and tracked movement for free.

CORE (recommended - Core build phase completed)
5x Tank (+1)
6x Infantry (+1)
3x Anti-Tank
3x Reconnaissance
2x Flak
5x Artillery (+1)
4x Fighter Aircraft
4x Tactical Bomber
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-briliant.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.reaction-briliant.text: The final Kursk belt held and the counterattack recovered the positions. Headquarters is preparing for an offensive now. I can finally take that news to the reserve.
line.reaction-victory.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.reaction-victory.text: Kursk ended with the German attack exhausted and our reserve still capable of moving forward. The strategic direction of the war has changed under our feet.
line.reaction-tactical.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.reaction-tactical.text: We held at Kursk, but nearly every reserve had to go in. Give me the casualty returns before I address the units. They will expect me to have read them.
line.callback-choice-a.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.callback-choice-a.text: You sent us in before we had all the reports at Prokhorovka. We got moving in time. I still owe the second echelon an explanation of the changes we made on the way.
line.callback-choice-b.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.callback-choice-b.text: Waiting gave us a coordinated attack at Prokhorovka. The troops already defending paid for the delay. I'm including their reports with ours.
line.earned-decision.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.earned-decision.text: Prokhorovka remained in our hands and the core kept enough formations intact to continue west. One Guards replacement group can be retained or broken up before the winter advance.
line.earned-decision.choice.retain-kursk: Retain the replacement group as a Guards infantry detachment.
Add an experienced eight-strength Guards infantry detachment to the core.
line.earned-decision.choice.spread-kursk: Use the Guards cadres to train the armoured and artillery formations.
Give tanks and artillery 22 experience and fully replenish ammunition.
line.earned-a-response.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.earned-a-response.text: Keep its officers with it. I can assign a formed detachment work that a replacement draft isn't ready for.
line.earned-b-response.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.earned-b-response.text: Put the Guards cadres with the gunnery instructors. I want the crews to practise with them before the next attack.
line.scene-0.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.scene-0.text: These villagers reached us before our patrols: bridges still standing, mined roads, rear guards. Some staff officers recognise the names. Please don't mark a route confirmed just because it leads home.
line.scene-1.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.scene-1.text: My sister's district is three columns below Zhytomyr on Sokolova's list. I have not asked her to mark the house. We issue the same road rules whether it still stands or not.
line.decision.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.decision.text: We could break through toward Berdychiv, or advance on a broader front and reach more villages together. Anna, I want the quick route. I also want to know who we'll leave waiting beside it.
line.decision.choice.rupture-and-exploit: Concentrate on one rupture and release the mobile group toward Berdychiv as soon as it opens.
Fully refuel the core, give tank and reconnaissance formations 25 experience each, and gain 100 prestige for deep exploitation.
line.decision.choice.advance-on-a-broad-: Clear the objective belt in parallel and keep neighbouring armies connected.
Restore the core to at least nine strength with full fuel and ammunition and give infantry and artillery 15 experience each.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.choice-a-0.text: The breakthrough group carries bridging stores and fuel ahead of comfort. Strongpoints outside the corridor are masked until the second echelon arrives.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.choice-a-1.text: Give the civilian guides escorts and a way home. Record their names and what we requisition. They should know where to come if we fail to return it.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.choice-b-0.text: I'll report the villages cleared and the German columns withdrawing between them. A broad advance will let more of those columns get away.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.choice-b-1.text: And don't mark a town liberated before a patrol has reached it. My sister can wait one more day for news I can trust.
line.post-0.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.post-0.text: Leave my sister's house off the map, Anna. You have enough routes to check. If there's news, bring it to me afterward.
